item.title: Rallying Cry – June 20, 2026
item.description: Morocco’s Saibari scored the fastest World Cup 2026 goal, a Japanese girl band’s six-year grind pays off with global fame, St Kilda pier wins a top architecture award, and three friends raise $44,000 for cancer research by running a 10-day relay in China.
